svg.title: Wealth and the path of losses
svg.desc: Minimum-variance and equal-weight simulated wealth with signed drawdown including initial cash. These are generated paths, not observed returns.
svg.text: Wealth and the path of losses
SYNTHETIC DATA · Four generated assets · Seed 42 · Same dates, execution lag and fees
02 Drawdown from each path's running peak
Initial wealth 100,000; 60-return lookback; rebalance every 21 observations; target weight cap 50%; 10 bps per side.
Signals at close t execute at close t+1. Fractional shares and full liquidity assumed; no terminal liquidation fee.
